children: SIGNS AGREEMENT TO SELL ITS 20% STAKE IN OPAL GAS PIPELINE TO HY24
TRANSACTION COMPRISES 100% OF SHARES IN LUBMIN-BRANDOV ASSETS GMBH & CO. KG, WHICH HOLDS A 20% CO-OWNERSHIP INTEREST IN OPAL
REMAINING 80% CO-OWNERSHIP INTEREST IS HELD BY GASCADE GASTRANSPORT GMBH
COMPLETION OF TRANSACTION REMAINS SUBJECT TO REQUIRED REGULATORY APPROVALS AND NON-EXECUTION OF A PRE-EMPTION RIGHT BY FRACTIONAL CO-OWNER
